name: San Antonio Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A warm, dry Central Coast AVA in the Santa Lucia Range of Monterey County, with Lake San Antonio in its southeastern corner.
